partner_result.use: bathtub extremization plus exact finite-fragment approximation, applied to bounded truncations of an unbounded singular payoff

additional_result.use: applied orientation-free rank-two half-Riesz bound to the scalar-Schur density inequality

new_results: Exact equality of worst-case expectation of every measurable nonnegative, possibly unbounded payoff across arbitrary cap-one product laws and compact finite-fragment unit-set products.
Exact half-Riesz localization for |quadratic+affine-t|^{-alpha}, alpha>0, via truncation and monotone convergence.
Worst-case singular-potential constant is invariant under affine changes c->c+2Bs and therefore depends only on the kernel component of c.
Scalar-Schur bridge p_Q(t)<=|a|^{-1/2} E|t-S(Y)|^{-1/2} is compatible with finite-fragment localization with zero loss.
For an exact-rank-two Schur remainder, ||p_Q||_inf<=128|a|^{-1/2}|det Lambda|^{-1/4}; improved source constant 16sqrt(30) when the Schur affine term has zero kernel component.
unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-free half-Riesz bound for the relevant arbitrary higher-rank Schur remainder, including the essential kernel-affine component, or close the near/zero physical-pivot branch by a different product-preserving mechanism.
